composition.serve_who: Sheet 5, titled “MAST BLOCK: DANFOSS PVG 32 – 6 FUNCTIONS,” serves the lifting keel through EV-6.1 up/down and EV-6.2 locks, and four individually named mast winches through EV-6.3 to EV-6.6. The common inlet, P/T/load-sense galleries, section-to-section bus, test point, and end section serve the Danfoss PVG 32 mast manifold rather than any single actuator.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Both leftmost function slices explicitly name the lifting keel: EV-6.1 controls keel up/down and EV-6.2 controls the lifting-keel locks; the authoritative mapping assigns both labels to this node.

functions.label: Lift and lower the lifting keel
functions.what_it_does: Meters hydraulic oil to move the lifting keel down or up, with proportional electrical command and load-sense pressure control.

flow_scenarios.path: Manifold line P → open-neutral PVG spool → line T; keel work lines A and B remain in the slice’s drawn neutral condition, and the selected load signal returns through the section load-sense network.

Pressured oil from line P → proportional directional spool → work port A → lifting-keel actuator in the DOWN direction; displaced oil → work port B → spool → line T. The corresponding load pressure is selected through the shuttle/load-sense branch and limited by its adjustable LS limiter.

Pressured oil from line P → proportional directional spool → work port B → lifting-keel actuator in the UP direction; displaced oil → work port A → spool → line T. The corresponding load pressure is selected through the shuttle/load-sense branch and limited by its adjustable LS limiter.

functions.dry_data: Danfoss PVG 32 module; 40 l/min spool; proportional PVEU, 0–10 V; DOWN <5 V=A, UP >5 V=B; open neutral; EV-6.1.

functions.label: Insert and withdraw the lifting-keel locks
functions.what_it_does: Directs low-flow hydraulic oil to drive the lifting-keel locking mechanism IN or OUT and hydraulically holds it in neutral.

flow_scenarios.path: Line P → closed-neutral directional spool, blocked; lock work ports A and B are blocked through the centered spool, so no commanded actuator or return flow occurs.

Pressured oil from line P → section pressure-control stage → shifted spool → work port A → lifting-keel lock actuator in the IN direction; displaced oil → work port B → spool → line T. A-side overpressure is discharged to T by the 180 bar work-port relief.

Pressured oil from line P → section pressure-control stage → opposite spool position → work port B → lifting-keel lock actuator in the OUT direction; displaced oil → work port A → spool → line T. B-side overpressure is discharged to T by the 180 bar work-port relief.

functions.label: Drive the aft-port mast winch in its selected winch direction/gear
functions.what_it_does: Routes hydraulic oil to either winch motor port according to the winch’s commanded state: states 1 and 3 use port A, while state 2 uses port B.

flow_scenarios.path: Manifold line P → open-neutral PVG spool → line T; no commanded drive flow is sent to the aft-port winch motor.

Pressured oil from line P → shifted directional spool → work port A → aft-port mast winch motor; motor return → work port B → spool → line T. The two motor work branches are protected by the drawn 250 bar and 230 bar relief paths to return; exact A/B assignment of those two settings is not cleanly readable.

Pressured oil from line P → opposite spool position → work port B → aft-port mast winch motor; motor return → work port A → spool → line T. The two motor work branches are protected by the drawn 250 bar and 230 bar relief paths to return; exact A/B assignment of those two settings is not cleanly readable.

infrastructure.system_name: Danfoss PVG 32 mast block common hydraulic infrastructure
facts: Sheet title identifies one six-function Danfoss PVG 32 mast block.
The common drawn manifold structure comprises pressure line P, tank/return line T, load-sense line LS, sectional LS_A/LS_B passages, and measuring/test connection M.
The left inlet/control section distributes P and T and includes the main block pressure relief, drawn from the pressure passage to return and set to 300 bar.
The six function sections are connected only through the drawn common galleries and section interfaces; their external A/B hoses serve the actuator named above each slice.
The right-hand end section terminates the common galleries; it is manifold infrastructure, not a seventh equipment function.
No manifold-wide total flow capacity is printed; all 5, 40, and 65 l/min figures are per-function spool ratings.

discarded_as_clutter: Duplicate equipment-data legend rows restating each slice’s module, spool, actuation, port mapping, and neutral data after those facts were composed into the functions
Title-block ownership, address, telephone, email, job/client/project administration, drafter/checker, scale, sheet count, file name, and legal notice
Revision-table dates and unrelated historical modification rows
Red numbered warning triangles as revision markers rather than hydraulic components
Repeated rail labels at each section boundary
Fine cartridge part numbers where the functional role is already identified; capture at inspection only if ever needed
Prior extraction’s duplicate pseudo-slice that mislabeled the block inlet as lifting-keel up/down
Prior extraction’s partial right-edge pseudo-function; it is the drawn block end section, not an additional equipment function
uncertainties: EV-6.1’s two load-sense limiter values and their A/B assignment are not cleanly readable at this resolution; no values are asserted.
For EV-6.3, the paired 250 bar and 230 bar work-port relief settings are visible, but their exact assignment to external ports A and B is not cleanly resolved.
For EV-6.4, the paired 250 bar and 225 bar work-port relief settings are visible, but their exact assignment to external ports A and B is not cleanly resolved.

Revision 10 is titled “PROPORTIONAL AFT WINCHES,” while the visible per-slice specifications for the mast winches read PVEO ON/OFF; the sheet does not clearly resolve whether the revision description refers to another control aspect or whether slice text was not updated. The visible slice data is retained without inventing a proportional command relationship.
